title: Electrochemical characterization of Z-scheme charge transfer in biomass-derived ZnO/carbon dots for efficient tetracycline degradation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,24726-24738
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02606G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wan Nuraishah Wan Ishak, Huey Ling Tan, Noor Fitrah Abu Bakar, Norbert Radacsi, Ying Pei Lim
This study investigates the electrochemical properties of a zinc oxide/carbon dots (ZnO/CDs) nanocomposite synthesized via a hydrothermal route, where biomass-derived CDs enhance charge separation and extend visible-light absorption.
